svg.aria-label: About: I build developer tools, AI dev tools inside the editor (Infinity Coder, PromptPilot) and web apps like Designly

g.text: I like building tools that make other developers faster, and products people enjoy using.
Lately that means AI dev tools that live inside the editor: Infinity Coder, a full coding agent
for VS Code, and PromptPilot, which cleans up Claude Code prompts. Plus polished web apps
like Designly, a free in-browser design editor.
◆ Right now: building AI-powered tools and sharpening my craft across the full stack
◆ I care about: safety by default, tests, CI with GitHub Actions, clean deploys
◆ Open to: dev tools, VS Code extensions, AI + editor integrations, creative web apps
